description: This file defines an Android Activity named Grid3 that demonstrates the use of a selectable GridView with multiple choice mode. It includes custom adapter and layout classes for displaying app icons, manages app loading via PackageManager, and handles selection events.

classes.name: Grid3
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up a GridView with multi-selection capabilities and loads app icons.

classes.name: AppsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for providing app icons to the GridView.

classes.name: CheckableLayout
classes.description: Custom layout that implements Checkable and changes background when selected.

classes.name: MultiChoiceModeListener
classes.description: Listener handling multi-selection action mode events for the GridView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads apps, and sets up the GridView and its listeners.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Queries the PackageManager for launchable applications.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Provides the view for each item in the GridView.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Sets the checked state for CheckableLayout and updates background accordingly.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Returns whether the CheckableLayout is checked.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the checked state of CheckableLayout.

methods.name: onCreateActionMode
methods.description: Creates the contextual action bar for multi-selection mode.

methods.name: onPrepareActionMode
methods.description: Prepares the action mode (no specific prep here).

methods.name: onActionItemClicked
methods.description: Handles action bar item clicks (not implemented here).

methods.name: onDestroyActionMode
methods.description: Cleans up when multi-selection mode ends (empty here).

methods.name: onItemCheckedStateChanged
methods.description: Updates UI or status when selection changes.
